title: Chhattisgarh Government Schools (Samagra Shiksha & PM POSHAN) Audit

scope: Samagra Shiksha and PM POSHAN budget allocations vs actual expenditure
UDISE+ district-wise school infrastructure (toilets, drinking water, classrooms)
